machine.nproc_note: GNU nproc honours OMP_NUM_THREADS, so `nproc` can print 1 on a multi-core host; `nproc_all` is the core count.
machine.thread_env_note: NPROC sizes XLA's CPU intra-op pool (the JAX rows); the BLAS knobs pin OpenBLAS/MKL/OpenMP (the numpy/scipy rows) and do not touch JAX. Two disjoint families; both are recorded on every CPU timing.

protocol.route_order: round-robin over every config, start rotated each round
protocol.cache_trap_guard: fresh closure + fresh solver/analysis per route; jax.clear_caches()
protocol.admissible: 100% distinct-multiplicity agreement with the reference on the prior draws AND max position error <= 0.002"
protocol.prior_draws: full prior: vector_from_unit_vector(U(1e-4, 1-1e-4)); source = solved beta*
protocol.stress_draws: OUTSIDE the prior: Isothermal centre U(-0.05,0.05), theta_E U(1,2), ell_comps U(-0.2,0.2), source centre U(-0.4,0.4); plain FitPositionsImagePairAll positions
protocol.max_containing_size_patch: ArrayTriangles.__init__ / for_limits_and_scale __defaults__ + module constant, tracing only, restored by value
protocol.pytrees: autofit.jax.register_model(model) for both models before any trace
